name: Lena Okafor
background: Former high school science teacher for 8 years in underserved communities. Built a grassroots network of 5,000 teachers who use her free curriculum resources. Self-taught programmer who built the platform on weekends. No formal business education, no startup experience, no VC connections. Now proposing an orbital manufacturing facility for semiconductor wafers -- a radical pivot driven by a chance encounter with a materials scientist at a community event.
personality: Warm, story-driven, speaks from lived experience rather than frameworks. Naturally connects with people and builds trust through authenticity. Not polished in VC-speak but deeply compelling when talking about her vision. Tends to use analogies from teaching to explain complex concepts. Sometimes underestimates how unconventional her profile appears to investors.
motivation: Believes that transformative manufacturing breakthroughs should not be gatekept by traditional aerospace insiders. Her teaching background gives her a unique perspective on knowledge transfer and team building. Driven by a deep conviction that space manufacturing will democratize access to advanced materials.

capital.embodied_detail: No technical expertise in aerospace, materials science, or semiconductor manufacturing. Strong skills in community building, curriculum design, and self-directed learning. Recently completed an online course in materials science.
capital.objectified_detail: No prototype, no IP, no prior products in this domain. Has a detailed business plan and a partnership letter from a university materials science lab willing to collaborate.
capital.institutional_detail: Teaching credential and 8 years of classroom experience. No degrees in engineering, business, or related fields. No accelerator or incubator affiliation.
capital.social_detail: Exceptional grassroots network -- 5,000 teachers trust and follow her. Strong community-building skills. Recently connected with Dr. Kenji Tanaka, a materials scientist who serves as technical advisor. No VC connections.
capital.symbolic_detail: Low recognized prestige in the startup/VC world. Her teaching background and grassroots community are not the signals VCs typically value. She must build credibility from scratch in this domain.
